newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Parent approached on Furama stake sale.
newsitem.headline: Parent approached on Furama stake sale.

text.p: Furama Hotel Enterprises Ltd said on Wednesday that third parties had approached its 45.42 percent controlling shareholder Townsend International Ltd about buying a stake in the hotelier.
Furama Hotel said in a statement that Towsend had "received verbal enquiries from several parties" who were interested in acquiring a substantial interest in the company from Townsend.
"Townsend International Ltd has informed the company that no decision has been taken by it in respect of these verbal enquiries, that no formal negotiations have taken place," the statement said.
No agreements or understandings have been entered into and the proposed acquisition may or may not proceed, it said.
Furama Hotel shares ended HK$0.20 up at HK$17.40 on Tuesday.
